meta.shellLabel: Module 1 · Lesson 1 · Money In, Money Out
meta.learningOutcome: I understand the basics of recognising spending triggers
meta.conceptTruth: Impulsive spending happens quickly, but can be stopped by pausing before acting
meta.behaviourShift:
From spending immediately when something feels exciting
 → To pausing before spending to decide if it is worth it
meta.ruleEnforcement: I always pause before buying something I want
